issues.title: [swarm][events-w1] Recover events_page tooling + fragment loader (gate)
issues.body:
## Swarm packet — Wave 1 gate (serial)

**Repo:** `WalksWithASwagger/kriskrug-wp` (+ sibling `kk-kb` for one push)
**Wave:** `swarm-wave-1` — must land before any Wave 2 issue starts
**Plan:** Events archive full backfill (finish 2026 → 2025 → 2024)
**Live page:** WP `2250` `/events/` (do **not** mutate live in this issue)

## Why this exists

Uncommitted `scripts/events_page/` + `backup/20260801-events-inventory/` were swept into `stash@{0}` while the checkout moved to `cursor/publications-aurora-tearsheet`. Without recovery + a protected branch, Wave 2 agents have no SSOT.

## Context / evidence

- Newest tooling (catalog media IDs `12662`–`12670`) lives in `stash@{0}` untracked tree (`stash@{0}^3`).
- `stash@{1}` is an older intermediate — do **not** restore from it.
- kk-kb Pitch Night + edition index: branch `content/events-page-phase0-20260801` (commit `2504f97b9`, not pushed).

## Ownership (exclusive)

- `scripts/events_page/**` restore + commit
- `backup/20260801-events-inventory/**` restore (leave untracked if gitignored)
- Fragment loader wiring so Wave 2 never edits the same YAML keys

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Selective restore **without** `stash pop` / `stash drop`:
  `git restore --source='stash@{0}^3' -- scripts/events_page backup/20260801-events-inventory`
- [ ] Verified: `events-catalog.yaml` has media IDs `12662`–`12670`; `meetup-editions.yaml` has 31 editions
- [ ] `lib.py` loads optional fragments from `scripts/events_page/fragments/*.yaml` (merge by `id`, core catalog wins on conflict) so Wave 2 packs never touch the core file
- [ ] Empty placeholder files committed: `fragments/one-offs-2026.yaml`, `fragments/one-offs-2025.yaml`, `fragments/one-offs-2024.yaml` (each `# owned by issue …` header + `events: []`)
- [ ] Tooling committed on branch `content/events-page-tooling` cut from `main` in a **temp worktree** (do not disturb `cursor/publications-aurora-tearsheet`)
- [ ] Draft PR opened for that branch
- [ ] kk-kb: push `content/events-page-phase0-20260801` + open draft PR (Pitch Night appearance + `EDITION-HERO-INDEX.*`)
- [ ] README notes fragment ownership + Wave 2/3 handoff

## Tests/Evals

- `python3 scripts/events_page/render_events_page.py` (or documented dry-run) succeeds against restored catalog
- Fragment loader unit smoke: empty fragments do not change event count vs core-only

## Verification

- `git status` on tooling branch shows only `scripts/events_page/` committed; backups not force-added if gitignored
- PR URLs posted in issue comment
- `stash@{0}` still exists after restore

## Agent Instructions

- Keep the publications/tearsheet working tree clean — use a fresh worktree from `main`.
- Do not POST to WP page 2250.
- Do not add 2024/2025/2026 one-off rows (Wave 2 owns those fragments).
- Do not implement `fetch_event_heroes.py` (Wave 2 hero-engine issue).

## Out of Scope

- Live `/events/` deploy
- Hero downloads / Rafiki / media uploads
- Catalog content for years 2024–2026 one-offs

## Dependencies

- Blocks: all Wave 2 + Wave 3 events-archive issues
- Blocked by: none

issues.title: [swarm][events-w2] Hero fetch engine (script only)
issues.body:
## Swarm packet — Wave 2 parallel

**Repo:** `WalksWithASwagger/kriskrug-wp`
**Wave:** `swarm-wave-2` — start only after Wave 1 tooling PR exists on `content/events-page-tooling`
**Branch tip:** branch from `content/events-page-tooling` (or main once merged)

## Why this exists

Year packs and meetup polish need a shared resolution order for card art. This issue owns **the script only** so catalog agents do not invent competing fetch logic.

## Ownership (exclusive — no overlap)

- **May create/edit only:** `scripts/events_page/fetch_event_heroes.py`
- **May append only:** hero-engine section in `scripts/events_page/README.md`
- **Must not touch:** `events-catalog.yaml`, `meetup-editions.yaml`, `fragments/**`, live WP, media uploads

## Resolution order (implement dry-run default)

1. Tracked repo asset path already on the event record
2. YouTube `maxresdefault` when `youtube_id` present
3. `og:image` from `event_url` (Luma/Eventbrite) or local kk-kb appearance HTML snapshot path if provided
4. Optional Rafiki branded tile flag (`--allow-rafiki`) for remaining gaps — off by default

Outputs: write candidate files under `scripts/events_page/heroes/_engine_cache/` (gitignored) and print a JSON report of `{id, source, local_path}` — **do not** write media IDs back into catalog (Wave 3 ship owns sync).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `fetch_event_heroes.py --dry-run` is default; no network writes to WP
- [ ] Accepts a list of event dicts / catalog path + optional `--ids`
- [ ] Documented CLI in README
- [ ] Fixture or unit test covers YouTube URL construction + missing-field skip
- [ ] `.gitignore` entry for `scripts/events_page/heroes/_engine_cache/` if cache is used

## Tests/Evals

- Unit test for resolution order with temp fixtures (repo path hit, youtube hit, skip)
- Dry-run on current catalog prints without exception

## Verification

- `python3 -m pytest` on the new test (or repo-equivalent)
- `python3 scripts/events_page/fetch_event_heroes.py --dry-run` exits 0

## Agent Instructions

- Open a focused PR against `content/events-page-tooling` or `main` once tooling lands.
- If Wave 1 is not merged yet, stack the PR on that branch and note the dependency in the PR body.

## Out of Scope

- Uploading to WP media
- Editing fragment YAML or meetup edition rows
- Live page apply

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: Wave 1 recover/tooling issue
- Parallel with: 2026/2025/2024 one-off fragment issues + meetup polish issue
- Enables: Wave 3 ship (uses this script)

issues.body:
## Swarm packet — Wave 2 parallel

**Repo:** `WalksWithASwagger/kriskrug-wp`
**Wave:** `swarm-wave-2`
**Exclusive file:** `scripts/events_page/fragments/one-offs-2026.yaml`

## Why this exists

Live Past grid is missing eight delivered 2026 stages; five already-listed one-offs (CM, WAIFF, LaSalle, ChannelNext, Whistler) have no heroes. kk-kb appearances are the date/role SSOT.

## Ownership (exclusive — no overlap)

- **Only edit:** `scripts/events_page/fragments/one-offs-2026.yaml`
- Optionally add local hero binaries under `scripts/events_page/heroes/one-offs-2026/` (this issue's directory only)
- **Must not touch:** core `events-catalog.yaml`, `meetup-editions.yaml`, other fragments, live WP, `fetch_event_heroes.py`

## Add these Past cards (from kk-kb appearances)

| Date | Event | Role |
|------|-------|------|
| 2026-07-09 | SFU AI panel | panelist |
| 2026-07-09 | BC + AI Film Club July — Idea Lab | host |
| 2026-07-08 | AI Ethical Futures Lab w/ Morten Rand-Hendriksen | host |
| 2026-04-12 | YVR AI Welcome Salon (TED2026 week) | host |
| 2026-04-01 | Global AI Summit Vancouver panel | moderator |
| 2026-03-31 | Sea to Sky Gondola AI-ethics workshop | workshop-lead |
| 2026-02-01 | Vibe Working Workshop | workshop-lead |
| 2026-01-31 | FIRST Tech Challenge — Think Award | judge |

## Wire heroes for existing core cards (path only, no WP upload)

Set `image` (local path) on fragment override records **or** document exact source paths in the fragment for Wave 3 to apply — preferred: fragment entries with `id` matching core one-offs and `image:` pointing at tracked assets:

- CreativeMornings → `punk-rock-ai-creative-mornings.jpg` (source-packs/drafts)
- WAIFF → Tela Viva press thumb in keynotes pack
- LaSalle / ChannelNext / Whistler → existing YouTube thumbs in drafts/source-packs

Use stable `id` slugs (e.g. `2026-07-09-sfu-ai-panel`). Include `end` ISO with America/Vancouver offset, `kind: one-off`, `status: confirmed`, short blurb, `url` when known.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Fragment lists all 8 new events with required catalog fields
- [ ] Five existing heroless one-offs have resolvable local `image` paths (copy into `heroes/one-offs-2026/` if needed, keep under ~1MB each)
- [ ] `python3 scripts/events_page/render_events_page.py` dry-run includes the new titles when fragments load
- [ ] No live WP writes; no `sync_event_media.py --execute`
- [ ] PR only touches this fragment (+ optional `heroes/one-offs-2026/`)

## Tests/Evals

- Render dry-run HTML contains each of the 8 event titles exactly once
- YAML parses; duplicate `id` against core catalog called out in PR if loader cannot override

## Verification

- `rg -n "SFU AI panel|Vibe Working|FIRST Tech" scripts/events_page/fragments/one-offs-2026.yaml`
- Render output path noted in PR

## Out of Scope

- 2025/2024 events, meetup editions, TruNorth, live ship

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: Wave 1 tooling + fragment placeholders
- Parallel with: hero-engine, 2025 fragment, 2024 fragment, meetup polish
- Consumed by: Wave 3 ship

- **Must not touch:** `fragments/one-offs-*.yaml`, core upcoming one-offs, live WP media sync execute, page 2250

Prefer night photos (Michelle Diamond / Caswell) over promo posters when present on disk.

issues.title: [swarm][events-w3] Ship /events/ archive backfill (exclusive live apply)
issues.body:
## Swarm packet — Wave 3 ship (serial, exclusive)

**Repo:** `WalksWithASwagger/kriskrug-wp`
**Wave:** `swarm-wave-3`
**Live target:** WP page **2250** `https://kriskrug.co/events/`
**This is the only issue allowed to mutate page 2250 for this backfill.**

## Why this exists

Wave 2 lands fragments/heroes on branches. One coordinator merges, runs media sync, renders, snapshots, and applies — avoiding colliding live writes.

## Ownership (exclusive)

- Merge/rebase all Wave 2 PRs into `content/events-page-tooling` (or main)
- `sync_event_media.py` execute
- `fetch_event_heroes.py` for remaining `hero_hint` rows (incl. Rafiki only where no public asset)
- `render_events_page.py`
- Snapshot + REST apply page 2250
- Rollback manifest under `backup/20260801-events-backfill-ship/` (or dated equivalent)

## Pre-flight gates (do not ship if unmet)

- [ ] Wave 1 tooling PR merged or available as base
- [ ] Wave 2 PRs for: hero-engine, one-offs-2026, one-offs-2025, one-offs-2024, meetup-polish — all merged or explicitly waived by KK in comments
- [ ] Upcoming public set remains: Pitch Night (Sep 8), Van AI (Sep 30 / `luma.com/sept-ai`), Futureproof — **no TruNorth speaking claim**, no dead Aug Luma

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Pre-apply snapshot + rollback JSON recorded
- [ ] Dry-run render eyeballed; Past includes 31 meetups + 2024/2025/2026 one-off fragments
- [ ] `sync_event_media` uploaded missing heroes; catalog/fragments updated with media IDs
- [ ] Live cache-bypass fetch shows new titles (sample: Bass Coast, Innovate West, SFU panel, enriched #22)
- [ ] Spot-check Photon/image URLs return HTTP 200
- [ ] Rolloff script/attrs still present (`data-event-end`, upcoming/past buckets)
- [ ] Comment on this issue with: upcoming list, past card count, new media ID range, rollback path

## Tests/Evals

- `curl -sL 'https://kriskrug.co/events/?cb=$RANDOM' | rg -n "Bass Coast|Innovate West|How Can We Help|sept-ai|Futureproof"`
- Confirm TruNorth keynote wording absent
- Confirm `fe85bg28` / Aug 27 placeholder absent

## Verification

- Rollback file path posted
- Before/after HTML under `backup/.../page-snapshots/`

## Agent Instructions

- Snapshot-first; dry-run render before POST.
- Use `scripts/notion-to-wp/.env` for WP creds; never print secrets.
- If a Wave 2 PR is missing, stop and comment — do not invent events.
- Prefer merging PRs over re-implementing Wave 2 work.

## Out of Scope

- 2023 appearances
- Theme/Track B changes
- TruNorth role confirmation / public claim
- kk-kb appearance authoring beyond what's already on phase0 branch

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: Wave 1 + all Wave 2 events-archive issues
- Blocks: none (terminal ship)
